home.howSubtitle: First purchase? Three steps to receive safely
home.howStep1Title: Top up or pick a package
home.howStep1Desc: Top up by VietQR or USDT; the wallet is credited automatically. Or pick a package first and top up exactly what is missing.
home.howStep2Desc: The shop is not paid until you confirm or the protection period ends.
home.howStep3Desc: If something is wrong, open a dispute in the order; if it works, confirm to complete.
home.faq1A: When you pay, funds are held in escrow. The seller delivers, you check and confirm, then the funds are released. If there is a problem, open a dispute during the escrow period.
home.faq2A: Yes. While the order's protection time is running — it is shown on the product and in the order — open a dispute if the goods do not match the description. A refund goes back to your wallet.
home.faq3A: Some products are configured for automatic delivery. Once payment succeeds, you receive the account, proxy or API details without waiting for the seller to process the order.
home.faq4Q: How do I become a seller?
home.faq4A: Create an account, submit a store application with your store and contact details, and wait for approval. Once approved, you can publish products and start selling.
home.faq5A: Top up your wallet by bank transfer (VietQR) or USDT, then pay for orders from the wallet balance.
home.faq6A: Delivered goods are encrypted when stored and only shown to you in your order. The privacy policy explains what else we keep and why.
home.faq7A: Instant packages deliver right after payment. Other packages are delivered within the hours shown on the package; if the shop misses that deadline, the order is cancelled and refunded to your wallet.
home.faq8A: Yes. Choose a quantity on the product page, up to the stock shown for each package.
home.faq9A: Funds are held in escrow until the buyer confirms delivery or the escrow period ends. They are then transferred automatically to the seller's wallet.
home.faq10Q: Do proxies and accounts have a warranty?
home.faq10A: It depends on the seller and product. Warranty information is shown on each product page. If a product fails during its warranty period, you can open a dispute.
home.faq11A: For an order, open a dispute from the order itself. For everything else, the Help center lists the right place to go.
home.faq12Q: What if my account is locked?
home.faq12A: Accounts can be locked for breaking the terms or for unusual activity. See the Help center for how to reach GMMO.

guide.title: Create a bot in 2 minutes
guide.subtitle: Done in the Telegram app, no coding needed.

open.title: Open @BotFather
open.body: Search for @BotFather in Telegram and pick the account with the blue check — Telegram's official bot for making bots. Press Start.

newbot.title: Send /newbot
newbot.body: Type /newbot (or Menu → Create a new bot). BotFather asks for a name.

name.title: Choose a display name
name.body: Anything you like, e.g. Shop ABC Alerts.

username.title: Choose a username
username.body: No spaces, and it must end in bot, e.g. shopabc_notify_bot. Add a number if it is taken.

token.title: Copy the token
token.body: BotFather answers “Done! Congratulations…” with a line like 123456789:AA…. Tap it to copy, then paste it next to this guide.

guide.secret: The token is the bot's password: anyone holding it can post as your bot. GMMO never asks for it in chat or by phone. If it leaks: @BotFather → /mybots → your bot → API Token → Revoke current token, then paste the new token here.

token.webhookTitle: Another tool is using this bot
token.webhookBody: The bot posts its messages to another tool's webhook, so GMMO cannot receive the link code. The safest fix is a new bot used only for GMMO. If you no longer use that tool, you can remove its webhook.
token.webhookReplace: Remove the old webhook and connect

deliveryTime.q: How soon do I receive what I bought?
deliveryTime.a: Packages marked instant show the goods in your order right after payment. Other packages are delivered by the shop within the hours shown on the package; if the shop misses that deadline, the order is cancelled and the full amount goes back to your wallet.

findDelivery.q: Where do I find the goods I bought?
findDelivery.a: Open Orders and select the order. The delivery panel lists every line (#01, #02 …) with copy buttons and a .txt download. Proxies and API keys have their own panel in the same order.

autoComplete.q: When does an order complete on its own?
autoComplete.a: When the protection time shown in the order ends without an open dispute. The shop is then paid and the order can no longer be disputed, so check the goods early.

topUp.q: How do I top up my wallet?
topUp.a: Go to Wallet, enter an amount and choose bank transfer (VietQR) or USDT. For a bank transfer, keep the transfer message exactly as shown — it is how the payment is matched to your wallet.

depositMissing.q: I paid, but my wallet was not credited. What now?
depositMissing.a: Check that the transfer message and amount match the top-up request and that you paid before it expired. Keep the NAP-… code from the request and the bank transaction reference; you will need both if someone has to check the payment.

refundDestination.a: Back to your GMMO wallet, as available balance you can spend on the next order.

forgotPassword.a: Use "Forgot password" on the sign-in page. We email a reset link to the address on your account.

strangeSession.q: I see a sign-in I do not recognise.
strangeSession.a: Change your password in Account, then sign out the other sessions listed there. Changing the password also signs out every other device.

whenDispute.q: When can I open a dispute?
whenDispute.a: Once the order is delivered and while its protection time is still running. Open the order, choose what is wrong and, for accounts, the exact lines (#01, #02 …) that do not work.

evidence.a: Screenshots of the error, the time it happened and what you expected. Attach images to the dispute and hide passwords, codes and full card numbers first.

platformReview.q: The shop and I cannot agree. Can GMMO decide?
platformReview.a: Yes. From an open dispute, ask GMMO to review it with a short note. While the review is open the escrow stays held, and the decision is recorded in the order.

openShop.q: How do I open a shop?
openShop.a: Read the seller guide, then submit the three-step application. Every shop is reviewed before it can list products.

sellerPayout.a: Each order's money reaches the seller's wallet when its escrow time ends without a dispute, minus the platform fee. The payout schedule is on the seller's Withdrawals page.

neverOtp.q: Someone says they are from GMMO and asks for a code.
neverOtp.a: It is not GMMO. We never ask for passwords, verification codes or recovery codes. Stop replying and change your password if you already shared one.

offPlatform.q: A shop asks me to pay outside GMMO.
offPlatform.a: Decline. Only payments made through GMMO are held in escrow and can be disputed. Messages carrying outside contact details may be blocked.

review.q: How long does the review take?

payout.q: When does money reach my wallet?
payout.a: When each order's hold time ends without a dispute, or earlier if the buyer confirms. The seller Withdrawals page lists what will be released each day.

dispute.q: What happens when a buyer disputes?
dispute.a: The money stays held. You reply in the order — replace the item, refund it or explain — and either side can ask GMMO to review.

api.q: Can I resell proxies or API access?
api.a: Yes, through your own server registered as a provider. GMMO approves the provider before its products go on sale.
